title: The First Crash
topic: Hardware instability during a live stream
summary: EX_01 experienced a sudden hardware crash during a live stream on a 2019 Dell Precision with a Quadro T1000 GPU. The crash resulted in a black screen with no error message, highlighting hardware instability.
ex01Opinions: Trusted a machine with a 2019 GPU
compactScriptExcerpt: You know that feeling when your computer suddenly decides it's time to crash during a live stream? I did. On a 2019 Dell Precision with a Quadro T1000, no less. It didn’t stutter. It didn’t lag. It just… *poof*. Black screen. No error message. Just silence. And not the kind that’s cool. The kind that makes you question why you ever trusted a machine with a GPU from 2019.
